concepts.subject: Diverse Team Meeting Room
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a warm and inviting office meeting room with a diverse team of professionals seated around a wooden table. Use natural lighting, a mix of colors, and a low-angle camera shot to create a sense of inclusivity. Incorporate laptops, notepads, and a whiteboard with creative ideas. The mood is collaborative and innovative.
concepts.title: Diverse Team Collaborating in Office
concepts.description: A group of diverse professionals seated around a meeting table in a modern office, engaged in discussion and collaboration. The room is filled with natural light and features a whiteboard with creative ideas.

concepts.subject: Healthy Fitness Woman Outdoor
concepts.image_prompt: Create a vibrant and energetic outdoor scene of a healthy woman engaging in fitness activities in a park. Use a warm and sunny lighting style, a dynamic composition, and a bold color palette. Incorporate a fitness tracker, yoga mat, and a refreshing drink. The mood is energetic and uplifting.
concepts.title: Fit Woman Exercising Outdoors in Park
concepts.description: A healthy and fit woman engaging in outdoor fitness activities in a park, surrounded by lush greenery and vibrant flowers. She is wearing a fitness tracker and holding a yoga mat, with a refreshing drink nearby.

concepts.title: Delicious Breakfast Table with Fresh Fruits
concepts.description: A breakfast table setting with a variety of delicious food and drinks, including fresh fruits, baked goods, and a steaming cup of coffee. The scene is warm and inviting, with a cozy atmosphere.
